summary:
The Challenge: Addressing space exploration and education through an engaging, interactive digital experience that brings complex cosmic concepts to life for students and space enthusiasts.

The Solution: A custom-built, interactive 2D game developed using GDevelop. Players navigate a dynamic environment, dodge space obstacles, and collect vital mission items to learn about space navigation and resource management.

Key Features:

Smooth Physics & Mechanics: Implements robust collision handling, custom object separation, and boundary mechanics to ensure clean gameplay.

Dynamic Scoring System: Utilizes global variables to track progress and reward players in real-time as they gather mission-critical items.

Web-Accessible Build: Fully exported as an HTML5 web application, allowing judges and users to play the game instantly in any browser without installation.

Tools & Technologies: Built from scratch using GDevelop, featuring custom character sprite logic, obstacle positioning, and an integrated presentation overview detailing the mission objectives.
details: it is a game that illustrates how astronauts make live decisions
